text:
ash.marketing: Quick sync  coordinating influencer brief for tomorrow's benchmark post. Need final do/don't list and approved stat to give creators.

olivia.pr: Good call. We should limit the CTA: link to blog only, no comparative calls to action. Also include the embargo time: 08:00 PT.

nate.influencerops: Creators want a one-sentence highlight and one technical bullet. Can we approve: '95th pct latency typically under 220ms for 1k tokens on common GPUs'?

marta.legal: 'Typically under' is safer than absolute. Add dataset link and provenance. Also disclaimers for sponsored content.

julia.ceo: Approved line: "We aim to make inference predictable and cost-efficient in production." Use that for creator captions if they want a quote.

ben.engineering: Technical bullet suggestion: "Measurements run with production routing, KV-cache enabled; see appendix." That keeps it factual.

olivia.pr: Also require creators to avoid publishing any raw CSVs or unvetted screenshots. We will provide static assets.

nate.influencerops: Noted. We'll distribute an asset pack and the short script. Creators will sign NDA for embargo.

ash.marketing: I'll put together the influencer brief and the asset pack in the drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/marketing/influencer-pack-2205

pressbot: [automated] Note: embargoed outreach queued for official press list. Influencer scheduling separate.

support.team: Heads-up support will see community mentions. We'll prepare a short FAQ and triage owner list.

olivia.pr: One more thing: if a creator posts early, PR strategy is to (1) ask for takedown, (2) publish an official clarifying thread within 15 minutes, and (3) offer an official brief to affected reporters. Agreed?

julia.ceo: Agreed. Keep response rapid and factual.

nate.influencerops: We'll confirm posting windows with creators and ask for draft approvals. ETA asset distribution 3 hours.

marta.legal: I'll add a short sponsor disclosure template and approve the NDA text.

ash.marketing: Thanks all. Final checklist: assets in drive, NDA sent, approved stat + CEO quote in brief, embargo 08:00 PT. If no blockers we proceed.

olivia.pr: No blockers from PR. I'll queue pressbot at publish.

pressbot: [automated] Scheduled: embargo lift to 20 reporters at 08:00 PT on PR trigger. Thread closed for scheduling.
